career_ladder.note: Constables in Haryana Police are recruited for General Duty (Male & Female) and India Reserve Battalions (IRB). Promotions through non-gazetted and subordinate ranks are governed by the Punjab Police Rules (1934, as applicable to Haryana) and Haryana Police Act, 2007.

steps.source_label: HSSC Advt No. 01/2024 & 06/2024 (Recruitment of 6,000 Police Constables)

steps.years: approx. 8-12 yrs (subject to Lower School Course examination & merit)
steps.source_label: Haryana Police Non-Gazetted Ranks Promotion Rules

steps.years: approx. 15-20 yrs (subject to Intermediate School Course)
approx. 22-26 yrs (subject to Upper School Course)

steps.source_label: Haryana Police Service (State Police Service Promotion Quota)

exam_scheme.note: Under revised recruitment rules, only CET Group C qualified candidates can apply. The recruitment entails Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Screening Test (PST), followed by a 94.5-mark Knowledge Test and NCC bonus marks.

stages.source_label: HSSC Advt 01/2024 & Haryana Police Recruitment Rules

papers.paper_name: Running Endurance Test (Male: 2.5 km in 12 min; Female: 1.0 km in 6 min; Ex-Servicemen: 1.0 km in 5 min with RFID timing)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in nature within specified time limits

stages.source_label: Haryana Police Physical Standards (Height & Chest measurement)

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards (Male: Height 170 cm Gen / 168 cm Res, Chest 83 cm + 4 cm expansion; Female: Height 158 cm Gen / 156 cm Res)

stages.source_label: HSSC Knowledge Test Syllabus for Police Constable (100 Questions, 94.5 Marks, 105 Minutes)

papers.paper_name: Composite Knowledge Test — General Studies, Current Affairs, General Science, Reasoning, Mental Aptitude, Numerical Ability, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Basic Computer Knowledge (min. 10 questions), and Haryana GK
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 0.945 deducted if 5th bubble left blank
papers.qualifying_threshold: Competitive merit (plus up to 3 bonus marks for NCC certificates: C=3, B=2, A=1)

financial_package.note: Constables in Haryana Police are remunerated in Functional Pay Level 3 (FPL-3) under the Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, with entry basic pay of ₹21,700.
financial_package.pay_source_label: HSSC Advt 01/2024 & Haryana Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry Level 3 basic pay of ₹21,700 with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹12,586), HRA (8% to 24% depending on posting location), conveyance allowance, uniform washing allowance, and ration subsidy, minus standard deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) or designated police lines barrack/quarter accommodation
Haryana State Employees Cashless Medical Facility Scheme
Government Contribution to New Pension Scheme (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: Haryana Police Constable recruitment generates massive participation across the state, with multi-stage screening filtering hundreds of thousands of candidates.

years.source_label: HSSC Advt 01/2024 & 06/2024: 6,000 vacancies (5,000 Male Constable GD, 1,000 Female Constable GD); approx. 2,00,000 CET Group C qualified candidates applied.
HSSC Advt 04/2020: 7,298 Constable vacancies (5,500 Male GD, 1,100 Female GD, 698 Female HAP Durga-1); 8.39 lakh registered candidates.

official_downloads.note: Recruitment advertisements, PMT/PST admit cards, written test instructions, and final select lists are published by HSSC and Haryana Police.
